notes:
Account summary:
- Product: multi-tenant agent platform for SMB/Mid-market customers (chat + tool-calling).
- Priority: reduce time-to-first-token (streaming start) and keep p95 response delta <300ms for agent actions. Careful about token costs and predictable per-tenant billing.

Requirements / asks from call:
- Start with Hosted API demo/POC. If hosted meets latency SLOs in 2-week POC, move to dedicated reserved pools.
- Latency SLOs: target p50 <100ms for single-turn streaming start, p95 <300ms under typical tenant loads. Total end-to-end tool-call roundtrip target ~500ms (external tool endpoints excluded).
- Throughput: typical production mix = 65% streaming chat (short-turn), 25% long-running agent flows, 10% embeddings/rerank. Expected baseline 200 reqs/s aggregate; want per-tenant burst up to 150 rps with fair-share throttling.
- Quotas/rate-limits: need per-tenant soft quota + enforced hard caps; tenant tiers (free, pro, enterprise) with different QPS and token quotas. Want token accounting by tenant and per-route.
- Streaming stability: saw jitter in vendor demo; want deterministic chunk timing, stable reconnect/resume for interrupted streams. Ask: support for resumable streams and server-sent events / chunking config.
- Tool calling: must support function/tool calling with structured outputs and safe sandboxing; need retry/fallback semantics if webhook tool fails.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML + SCIM), KMS for key management, audit logs (user+token-level), data residency (EU customers) — legal asked for draft SOC2/ISO references and retention policy.

POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week hosted POC with Redwood:
  * Week 1: synthetic load (3 tenant profiles: free, pro, enterprise) run to validate p50/p95 streaming start and per-tenant quotas.
  * Week 2: integrate small agent flow with tool-calling (external API stubs) and validate streaming resume + fallback to non-streaming on connection issues.
- Success criteria: p95 streaming start under target, per-tenant quotas enforced as configured, no more than 2% dropped chunks under 95th percentile network conditions.

Customer quotations / color: "We need streaming to feel instantaneous for users — anything that makes the chat UI lag kills conversion." — Head of Product.

Commercial notes:
- Interested in conservative committed capacity for Dedicated (monthly) if POC shows >30% cost savings on tokens/throughput. Price sensitivity: wants predictable token/unit pricing and clear overage rules.
- Finance requested example TCO calculation comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for 12-month horizon (Drive: fulcrum-redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).

Open technical questions / follow-ups:
- Can Redwood expose per-tenant quota/usage events via webhook or pubsub for billing ingestion?
- Detailed streaming metrics available for SDK/console? Need per-tenant chunk timing, dropped-chunk counts, reconnects.
- Clarify model fallback policy for Dedicated: can we have lightweight quantized fallback when capacity constrained?

Next actions (short):
- SE (Priya) to deliver POC runbook and load script by 2025-02-07.
- AE (Jordan) to send updated pricing + sample TCO by 2025-02-09.
- Legal to start security questionnaire (customer sent initial template).

Internal notes / red flags:

- Strong emphasis on streaming UX — product team will demo their UI during POC to reproduce UX issues.
